points.description: Uses the bandwidth-delay product formula: BDP = link capacity × one-way propagation delay (equivalently writes 10 Mbps × 20 ms or 10,000,000 bps × 0.02 s).
Converts the given values to compatible units correctly: 10 Mbps = 10,000,000 bps (10^7 bps) and 20 ms = 0.02 s.
Computes the final bandwidth-delay product as 200,000 bits (accept 2 × 10^5 bits) and includes the unit bits.

rubric.notes: Full marks require the correct formula, correct unit conversions, and the final value 200,000 bits with units. A correct final answer alone earns only the final-answer point; an arithmetic slip after correct setup loses only the final-answer point. No part marks are allowed within any point.
